Implementation phase-cache stock bench v4 — 2026-10-13, Asia/Tokyo
Status: SOURCE IMPLEMENTED / ALL EXECUTION UNVERIFIED. No build, test, lint,
AST, project import, GPU/model/profiler, service or process operation was run.
No performance, numerical safety, compilation or provider PASS is claimed.
No commit/push performed: Main owns validation and the next committed boundary.

Base and destination
G=/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata
WC=G/.worktree/diag-native-copy-queue-qualified-20261013, unchanged.
Base=410904c99d273435b5302fa8976cc667d17957f2 (qualified C++ lineage a825e23).

Created a new worktree from that exact HEAD; root remains main, with no attempt
to repair historical root divergence. No branch switch or local identity change.
git-workflow SKILL.md and WC AGENTS.md applied. Explicit delegation supersedes
the skill's automatic commit/test instructions. Current W lacks LOCAL.md and
docs/ARTIFACT_RETENTION.md; user-provided retention instructions were followed.
No existing reports, receipts, registry, JSON, packet, measurement lock or large
captures were changed. The sensitive contract record.json was not read.
Only transient .orig/.rej produced by textual patch application in W were removed
as source-edit intermediates; no measurement or diagnostic artifact was removed.

CMakeLists.txt

Integration and preservation
Applied the v3 textual changes.patch to current qualified source, not its old
after files. CMake's changed core linkage was integrated by hand, preserving
the current ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS}. Existing prefill/gemm source was not changed at all:
native COPY cohorts, native-dequant-batch, issuer guards, StagerDone, and checked
release/reset lifetime are inherited from the current qualified base. Current
segmented verifier and session host-handoff fixes remain in place. Added owner
library is CPU-only; backend links through strata_core in free and contrib-llvm.

Frozen exact STRATA_PHASE_DECODE_CACHE=1 remains default OFF. Ordinary OFF does
not construct a phase owner. All v3 startup/source gates retained: immutable
native Host-USM arena and complete ranked profile, single GPU, no MTP/borrow,
chunk8192, no dynamic/reuse/cache/batch/pipeline/vision/remote/elastic settings,
explicit short-read0, fullcontext262144/int8KVresident32768. Native-dequant-batch1
is required, not disabled to fit. +16/layer is the named experimental quota,
not vendor dispatch or a measured optimum. Actual VMM/free/max capabilities and
512MiB live free guard admit or fail-stop; no reduced quota fallback. Ordinary
OFF remains the hardware fallback. Model mathematics, quantization, sampler,
input bounds, context_bounds::admission and output reserve are unchanged.

Actual cycle: baseline144 byte-verified slots with stable virtual base, full
capacity912 immutable slot offsets, complete checked device residency and stable
host table. Successful prompt drains producers/compute, retires Prefill::Impl
including Gemm scratch, maps/fills/reads back extras and checks Hres==Dres before
decode. Next GEN drains, destroys verifier captured window/resident/segmented/
commit/batch graphs while retaining the verifier object and its session/table
buffers, invalidates and checks residency, unmaps/drains/destroys physical owners,
then reinitializes Prefill on the same SessionState. Fresh session_zero follows,
with checked stream completion for phase mode. Normal QUIT retires readers and
closes the mapped owner before reservation/device-table release.

Additional concrete fixes found during integration
v3's phase_refresh local lambda was captured by reference into callbacks stored
past the enclosing if-block. It now lives through the entire serve loop.
ExpertCache::mapped_bytes now reports physical mapping bytes in phase mode rather
than incorrectly reporting reserved capacity. Graph retirement was made explicit
before the next GEN's extra detach, not inferred from stable pointer addresses.
PhaseServeCycle distinguishes active prompt, active decode and completed request;
complete_gen(false) poisons the cycle and cannot admit a later request.

Granularity and ownership contract
Read the installed v711 SYCL virtual_mem.hpp and physical_mem.hpp at
/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011/.tools/intel-llvm-v711/install/include/sycl/ext/oneapi/virtual_mem/
and original intel/llvm spec at
/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/intel/llvm/.worktree/toolchain-sycl-v711-b570-20261011/sycl/doc/extensions/experimental/sycl_ext_oneapi_virtual_mem.asciidoc.
API names used: get_mem_granularity(device, context, granularity_mode::minimum)
and get_mem_granularity(context, granularity_mode::minimum), plus existing
device recommended query. Check all context devices' VMM aspects before queries.
Caps retain all three, with device/backend/ordinal/context device count logged.
Main must additionally pin the full runtime/provider/library identity externally.

Checked LCM combines inherited2MiB extent policy, 256 payload stride, device
recommended/minimum and context minimum. Missing/zero/inconsistent query values,
LCM/add/multiply/pointer overflow, reservation budget/size/address, extent offsets/
sizes, physical allocation size/map address/zero physical offset and slot ranges
are rejected before map. Device recommended must be divisible by device minimum.
Slots are 256-aligned byte subranges, not separate VMM maps, and need not themselves
be minimum-page aligned. Extents are aligned to device and context minima; returned
base is checked against both. Fresh caps must remain identical across cycles.
Each physical handle backs one exact-sized extent at physical offset0. Unmap and
checked drain precede physical destruction; all maps and another drain precede
virtual release. Destruction is not an unmap substitute. Any uncertain operation
poisons/fail-stops; no retry, session reset or safe-result reinterpretation.

Stock request / caller contract
R337/R339/R345/R347 and v182 registry (872 entries) were reviewed for the relevant
existing conclusions; no new research result or duplicated measurement proposed.
Before begin_gen or any phase mutation, actual startup cache capacities must still
be zero, owner healthy/ready with expected144 or prior912 backing, SessionState/KV
geometry unchanged, live IDs/images/live_ok empty, checkpoints/tail/split part map
empty, conversations and reuse byte owners empty, disk cache disabled, no slots/
admission/split stages or failure flags. GENI/pin/PCIe/reuse commands remain excluded.
Resume/from_live/incoming/slot-source are initialized fresh for that request and
their concrete selection results are checked before restore paths; turn_at must
remain -1. Existing successful no-cache GEN metadata is explicitly discarded as
non-resumable, without dropping buffers or silently clearing unexpected checkpoints.
Next request performs normal fresh zero after retirement. ckpt bit itself is not
rewritten: omitted bit1 logs 'request bit defaulted; no checkpoint state exists'.
Explicit ckpt0 remains supported. Short warm-up executes the entire same protocol.
Cancel/nonfinite/failure cannot produce a successful completion and then continue.

HTTP engine environment exact flag is frozen per engine object. An enabled phase
experiment may spawn once, including a lazy first spawn. Automatic restart/reload
after death or unload raises EngineDied before reload hooks or cleanup/recreation;
no retry after failed startup. This closes R339's silent new-process contamination.
The upstream client/bench.sh and existing configs are unchanged. The new server
fixture covers exact child-env selection and repeated failed-lifetime refusal.

Main test instructions — NONE executed here
First finish the active GPU measurement. Serialize all tests/builds/GPU work under
Main's owned measurement workflow; do not overlap qualified WC jobs. Use W only,
never copy build artifacts or sources into WC. Pin this new source/binary/provider
closure; old receipts do not transfer. Review source and changed/new files first.

CPU without GPU runtime:
  cd W
  cmake -S . -B build/phase-host -DSTRATA_ENABLE_XE=OFF -DSTRATA_BUILD_TESTS=ON -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
  cmake --build build/phase-host --target phase_cache_owner_test
  ctest --test-dir build/phase-host -R '^phase_cache_owner_test$' --output-on-failure
Repeat in separate host build with -DSTRATA_SANITIZE=address,undefined and in
NDEBUG. Meaningful fixtures exercise actual owner bookkeeping, distinct context
granularity, missing/incompatible/overflow values, misaligned returned reservation,
actual-state admission, uncertain map/copy/publication/drain/release failures,
two GEN retirement order, each second-GEN retirement fault, and unsuccessful decode.

Server CPU tests:
  python -m unittest serve.test_server.PhaseExperimentLifetime -v
  python -m unittest serve.test_server -v
Main imports/runs them only after the current measurement is closed.

Build free and contrib-llvm using the existing qualified sourceLLVM recipe, with
this W as source and new build folders. Set STRATA_BUILD_TESTS=ON and export compile
commands. For free the compiler install above is the qualified starting point:
  cmake -S . -B build/free -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=<install>/bin/clang++ -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=<install>/bin/clang -DSTRATA_LICENSE=free -DSTRATA_ENABLE_XE=ON -DSTRATA_BUILD_TESTS=ON -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON
  cmake --build build/free --target strata phase_cache_owner_test phase_cache_vmm_test
For contrib-llvm use STRATA_LICENSE=contrib and the qualified CUDA-enabled LLVM
compiler/STRATA_CUDA_ARCHS/oneMath recipe from the current Main closure. Do not
substitute the non-CUDA free compiler and call that contrib-llvm qualification.
Run tools/lint/run.sh with actual build compile database, no new warnings/findings,
affected CPU CTest closure and server tests. Do not run all GPU CTests implicitly.

Tiny actual VMM manually under Main's exclusive hardware admission, finite wall
60s/startup300s/log1MiB/RSS128MiB owner protocol from the v3 plan:
  build/free/phase_cache_vmm_test --small-vmm
One synthetic layer/+2, owner request cap16MiB minus64KiB, actual aligned extent
geometry, genuine owned Host-USM source/end negatives, full payload/padding canaries,
Hres==Dres and two cycles with checked close. 77 is unavailable, never PASS. Runtime
overhead is not inferred from owner request cap; report observed values separately.
Repeat where applicable for contrib-llvm. NVIDIA runtime behavior is unverified.

Then new-binary default OFF and exact ON startup READY/normal QUIT, source/native
profile checks, health/fault gates, actual source/binary/provider identities.
Debug32K GEN128 and TWO fresh GENs in one process, first omitted ckpt (stock route),
second explicit ckpt0, then QUIT. Also warm-up short GEN followed by long GEN in the
same process; require full protocol on both and no reused tokens/checkpoints.
Check baseline addresses/offsets, maps144/912/144/912, byte/readback hashes, full
residency, actual free before/after Prefill/Gemm retirement, unchanged KV/GDN/PLE/QSA
contents at phase boundaries and fresh reset on next prompt, graph retirement and
recapture, no uncertain ownership. Controlled fault/cancel/nonfinite cases must
stop both engine lifetime and HTTP continuation; verify no automatic new engine.

Only after these gates run unchanged upstream bench.sh/client stock sequence in
matched OFF/ON arms using a new candidate config/binary/env and the same pinned
inputs; never edit existing quiet config/receipt. R339's spec4/GEN24 stock benchmark
is distinct from the debug spec2/GEN128 qualification. Record full suite order,
same-process identity, prompt lengths, actual request settings, cache/source counts,
phase fill/readback/detach/reinit overhead and end-to-end GEN time. Compare quality
under declared fixed-history/logits methodology; do not require generated text
identity simply because different residency changes floating-point reduction.

Remaining uncertainty
All compilation, lints, CPU results, actual provider granularities, real producer/
graph/completion lifetime, actual VMM/memory budgets, two-GEN content preservation,
HTTP end-to-end fail-stop and stock-suite timing remain unverified. Synthetic CPU
workspace callbacks do not prove GPU quiescence. Full262K input, smaller devices,
NVIDIA/non-Intel providers, RESTORE/reuse, batch, split/MTP/pipeline/vision/remote,
and broad distribution quality have no transferred qualification. The excluded
modes remain rejected by phase mode; default OFF preserves existing support.

Resume directly from this report and W source diff. Main must save source,
commands/environment, individual samples, correctness/fault outcomes and decisions
in Git at its next validated boundary; this report is not a progress backup.
